evidence.note: statementType is annotated as which 1.97(e) statement was present, when one was. Some(type) implies statementPresent; type-without-present is not a documented observation.

The class example writes statementPresent true with Some(e2-no-prior-knowledge) in one make. Every in-repo fixture does the same lockstep (tables/server/db-admin candor rows). No producer writes Some(type) with statementPresent false.

notes: Correction of r25-law-practice-domain-ids-statement-present-type D1. Schema None-default on type does not make false+Some legal. Present-without-type remains the extra legal arm (unknown kind); type Some without present is the forbidden 4th. Collapse to absent | present-untyped | e1 | e2. sizeFeeAssertionPresent stays the inventoried independent sibling.

evidence.note: Field contract: when hasBlankPage is true, page is undefined (and confidence drops to 0.8). Combined-true is declared illegal, not an independent 4th pair.
toBlueBook prints the blank placeholder when hasBlankPage is true and otherwise formats page; combined-true never has its own arm and the page payload is ignored.
The only hasBlankPage-true constructor omits page (None default) on '410 U.S. ___'. toBlueBook tests write hasBlankPage false with Some(page). No supported producer writes true+Some(page).

notes: Correction of r25-law-practice-domain-full-case-blank-page D1. False+None remains legal (page optional when not blank). Illegal is only true+Some(page). Variants: numbered-page | blank-placeholder | absent. Distinct from inventoried [unpublished, hasBlankPage].

evidence.note: isRange is true if this is a page or paragraph range; endPage/endParagraph are documented as the range ends ('570-75', 'N-M'). The flag restates presence of one of those ends.

Documented producer writes isRange true with Some(endPage) for '570-75', and the nested additional pincite as isRange false with no ends. Tests only construct isRange false without ends (including starPage true). No producer writes isRange true with both ends empty, or an end with isRange false.

notes: Correction of r25-law-practice-domain-pincite-info-range-ends D1. Legal triples: single locator 000, page-range 110, paragraph-range 101. Page vs paragraph exclusivity (#204) also forbids both ends. Distinct from inventoried [isRange, starPage]. footnoteEnd is a separate footnote-range locator and is not this flag.
